title: Mr. Madras
desc: An industrialist hires a young man to settle her disputes with a local criminal on her behalf.

title: Navagraha Nayagi
desc: Goddess Maari Amman blesses those who sincerely pray to her and teaches a lesson to those who are involved in wrongdoings by performing miracles and healing.

title: Meenava Nanban
desc: Kumaran, a brave adventurer, arrives to assist the fishermen, who were being taken advantage of by Nagaraj, an avaricious man.

title: Jannal Oram
desc: In Pannaikadu, a remote village with just one bus service, newcomers struggle to fit in. Over time, they break down barriers and discover the warmth as well as unity of village life.

title: Anjaneya
desc: A police officer goes undercover to infiltrate the mafia and collect incriminating evidence. During his operation, he receives assistance from Divya, who begins to have romantic feelings for him.
